headline: Walker's 177 bought 30-27. Herbert gets the thinner room.
dek: Kansas City is 4-0 after a 30-27 win at Allegiant Stadium, and after the Week 5 bye a 189-yard run game and a receiver room without Tyquan Thornton host the Chargers on Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT.
videoHook: Four-and-oh came out of Allegiant 30-27. Walker ran for 177, Thornton went down on the 55-yarder, and Justin Herbert is next at Arrowhead.
theEdge: ESPN FPI gives Kansas City a 71.6 percent win probability against Los Angeles, while Polymarket prices the Chiefs at 10.3 percent to win the championship and 18.5 percent to win the AFC. Favored at home is not a verdict: keep Walker's 189-yard identity and make Herbert throw into two-deep.

storyline.lede: Kansas City is 4-0 because Kenneth Walker III just ran 22 times for 177 yards in a 30-27 win at Allegiant Stadium, and because Patrick Mahomes still found the explosives on a 15-of-30 day. The tape that actually travels is less pretty: 24:18 of possession against 35:42, 18 first downs against 28, 10 quarterback hits and zero sacks on Kirk Cousins, and Tyquan Thornton leaving with a dislocated ankle after the 55-yard catch that set up the go-ahead score. The Week 5 bye is already over as a calendar item. Week 6 is Los Angeles at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, and the receiver room that just lost Thornton (long-term) and is already without Rashee Rice (short-term) has to answer Justin Herbert without pretending 4-0 is a finished product.
body: The 30-27 was a field-position and takeaway win more than a control win. Las Vegas posted 437 total yards and 365 net passing yards, and Cousins still walked off 31-of-52 with zero sacks. Kansas City's 399 yards were the other kind of 399: 189 on the ground, 210 through the air, zero turnovers, and just enough chunk plays — Xavier Worthy for 41, Thornton for 42 and 55 — to outrun a defense that could not get off the field. Matt Araiza's 12-yard rush from punt formation is a real snap in that 189; it is not the identity. Walker is.

What the bye cannot restock is the perimeter. Arrowhead Pride reports Thornton dislocated the ankle on that fourth-quarter catch-and-run and that Treydan Stukes was not fined; the same shop lists Rice as short-term and Thornton as long-term, with Kansas City among several teams interested in Justin Watson. Worthy’s four catches, including the 41-yarder, are exactly the vertical the offense needs more of, and they are also a thin substitute for a 111-yard, two-score afternoon that is now off the call sheet.

Steve Spagnuolo's problem is the inverse of Eric Bieniemy's. The front knocked Cousins around for 10 hits and still let him live; the next quarterback is Herbert, who will take those same 28 first downs if the rush stays as hits instead of sacks. Cover-2 has to take the 27-yard ball off the table. The zone blitz has to be a call, not a hope. Andy Reid's staff has six days of actual practice after the bye to decide how much of Week 6 is Walker downhill and how much is manufactured touches for Travis Kelce, who finished the Las Vegas game with two catches.

Next Sunday is not a coronation check. ESPN FPI hanging 71.6 percent at home is a favorite's tax on 4-0, and Polymarket's 10.3 percent championship ticket is the market saying the sample is still a sample. Beat Herbert with the run, two-deep, and a receiver plan that does not ask Worthy to be Thornton and Rice at once, and 4-0 still means something when Seattle arrives on Sun Oct 25, 7:20 PM CT.

lastGameReview.label: Week 4 · Sun, Oct 4 · 3:25 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City won 30-27 at Allegiant Stadium after Las Vegas went up 7-0 on a 27-yard Kirk Cousins touchdown to Ian Thomas at Q1 8:10, led 13-10 at halftime on field goals of 32 and 48 yards, and still had 28 first downs and 35:42 of the ball. The Chiefs tied it at 7-7 on a 2-yard touchdown at Q1 2:23, traded a 28-yard field goal, then took 17-13 on an 8-yard touchdown at Q4 14:50. Las Vegas answered with 44- and 48-yard field goals for 17-19. Kansas City went back in front 23-19 on a 2-yard touchdown at Q4 3:21, then Kenneth Walker III scored on a 22-yard run around right end at Q4 3:02 for 30-19 after J. Bassa forced a fumble on the kickoff and J. Cochrane recovered. Brock Bowers' 20-yard touchdown at Q4 1:46 made it 30-27; X. Nwankpa intercepted Cousins at Q4 0:10.

analysis.body: Mahomes' 15-of-30, 225-yard, two-touchdown tape was not a dink drive. It was a shot chart. He missed Worthy deep right on the opening series, then hit him for 41 yards to the Las Vegas 7 later in the first quarter, found Thornton for 42 yards to the 5 before halftime, and ripped Thornton again for 55 yards to the 5 at Q4 3:35 — the catch that drew Q. Walker's unnecessary-roughness flag and the play on which Thornton was injured. Two sacks and eight hits on Mahomes explain the incompletions. They do not explain the two-catch afternoons from Kelce and Noah Gray. When the intermediate game goes quiet, this offense lives on Walker and the deep middle, and that is a thin way to stay 4-0.

Walker was the entire early-down plan: 22 carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns, 23 touches. The 189 team rushing yards also include Araiza's 12-yard run from punt formation and a Khyiris Tonga report-eligible snap that gained nothing. Short yardage still leaked. Kansas City turned it over on downs at Q1 10:48 when Walker was stopped for 1 yard at the Las Vegas 49, and the 5-of-13 third-down mark is how you win a game while holding the ball 24:18. Bieniemy's identity ran through Allegiant. His conversion package did not.

Spagnuolo won the game with the run fit and the takeaways, not with the pass rush finishing. Las Vegas rushed 26 times for 72 yards; Ashton Jeanty still touched it 21 times (15 rushes, 6 catches) and Mike Washington Jr. added 10 touches, but the yards were not there. The yards were in the air: Cousins 31-of-52, 365 net passing, zero sacks, 28 first downs. Kansas City logged 10 quarterback hits and never dropped him. The stop that mattered on downs came at Q3 11:37 on an incompletion to Jeanty with Drue Tranquill covering and George Karlaftis in the picture. The fumble that mattered was Bassa's force and Cochrane's recovery on the kickoff after the 23-19 score. The interception that ended it was Nwankpa, with Karlaftis on the play, at Q4 0:10.

The fourth quarter also showed how penalties still donate drives. F. Anudike-Uzomah's roughing-the-passer flag at Q4 2:38 wiped a deep incompletion and moved Las Vegas 15 yards; L. Sneed's defensive holding at Q4 2:10 wiped another. Bowers scored from 20 yards at Q4 1:46. That is the same coverage stress Herbert will bring to Arrowhead if the rush remains hits without sacks and the secondary keeps playing extra snaps because the offense cannot stay on the field.

takeaways.title: Walker is the offense when the completion chart shrinks
takeaways.body: Twenty-two carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns, 23 touches. Kansas City's 189 rushing yards and 399 total yards were a run identity with explosives attached, not a balanced 15-of-30 passing game. If Thornton is out long-term, Bieniemy has to keep feeding Walker instead of asking Worthy to recreate a 111-yard afternoon by himself.

takeaways.title: Hits are not sacks, and 28 first downs are the warning
takeaways.body: Cousins went 31-of-52 with zero sacks against 10 quarterback hits, and Las Vegas still piled 437 yards and 35:42 of possession. Nwankpa's interception and the Bassa-Cochrane fumble won 30-27. Herbert will not donate those if the front keeps hitting and not finishing.

takeaways.title: The receiver room changed on the 55-yarder
takeaways.body: Thornton's five catches, 111 yards, and two touchdowns were the passing game, and he dislocated the ankle on the 55-yard catch at Q4 3:35. Worthy’s four catches and the 41-yarder are the remaining vertical. Kelce and Gray combining for four catches is not a replacement plan for Los Angeles.

whatWorked: Kenneth Walker III: 22 carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns, 23 touches inside a 189-yard team rushing day
Chunk passing: Worthy 41 yards, Thornton 42 and 55 yards, on the way to Mahomes' 225 yards and two touchdown throws
Takeaways: J. Bassa forced and J. Cochrane recovered the kickoff fumble; X. Nwankpa intercepted Cousins at Q4 0:10
Run defense: Las Vegas 26 rushes, 72 yards, with Jeanty held to volume without the yards
Matt Araiza: 12-yard rush from punt formation and AFC Special Teams Player of the Week after dropping all five punts inside the 20
whatDidnt: Possession and first downs: Kansas City 24:18 and 18 first downs against Las Vegas 35:42 and 28 first downs
Third down: 5-of-13, plus the Q1 10:48 turnover on downs at the Las Vegas 49
Pass rush finish: 10 quarterback hits, zero sacks on Cousins, 365 net passing yards allowed
Protection: two sacks and eight hits on Mahomes in a 15-of-30 day
Receiver volume behind the explosives: Kelce two catches, Gray two catches, then Thornton injured
Q4 penalties that extended Las Vegas: Anudike-Uzomah roughing, L. Sneed defensive holding, before the 20-yard Bowers touchdown

currentState.lede: The Chiefs are 4-0 through a Week 5 bye as the AFC's last unbeaten, with 1,648 yards of total offense through four weeks, and they are also a team that just won 30-27 while losing the clock, the first-down chart, and a starting receiver. The work for Week 6 is not rest. It is converting 10-hit pressure into sacks, replacing Thornton's 111 yards without pretending Worthy is a finished WR1, and keeping Walker's 22-carry identity as the thing Herbert has to solve first.

workOn.title: Finish the rush
workOn.body: Ten quarterback hits and zero sacks on Cousins is how Las Vegas sat on the ball for 35:42 and posted 28 first downs. Herbert will take that same script at Arrowhead unless Karlaftis, Anudike-Uzomah, and the simulated-pressure package actually drop him.

workOn.title: Third down and the 24:18 problem
workOn.body: A 5-of-13 day and 18 first downs against 12 drives is how you need takeaways to survive 30-27. Bieniemy has to manufacture Kelce and Gray completions so Mahomes is not hunting another 55-yarder every series.

workOn.title: A receiver plan that survives Thornton
workOn.body: Thornton is long-term after the dislocated ankle; Rice is already short-term. Worthy’s four catches cannot be the entire vertical answer against Los Angeles, and the Watson interest is a familiarity patch, not a scheme.

workOn.title: Short yardage
workOn.body: Tonga reported eligible and gained nothing; Walker was stopped for 1 yard on downs at the Las Vegas 49. Arrowhead Pride's four-week short-yardage look is now a live problem if the Chargers load the box for Walker.

thinkAbout.title: Watson reunion versus an actual wideout
thinkAbout.body: Arrowhead Addict frames the Justin Watson interest as familiarity over upside, while Arrowhead Pride says Kansas City is one of several teams in that mix and could revisit the offseason receiver plan. The staff has to decide whether Week 6 is a patch or a hunt.

thinkAbout.title: How much Worthy can carry
thinkAbout.body: Arrowhead Addict wants more of Worthy's explosive Week 4; an ESPN insider on that same site questions whether he can solve the receiver crisis. The honest read is that the 41-yarder is real and that 4 catches is not a Thornton replacement.

thinkAbout.title: Walker volume versus a passable third down
thinkAbout.body: Twenty-three touches won Allegiant. If Los Angeles sells out to stop the 177-yard tape, Mahomes still has to complete something other than go balls, and Kelce's two-catch afternoon cannot repeat.

thinkAbout.title: Two-deep or heat on Herbert
thinkAbout.body: The last tape allowed 365 net passing with no sacks. Spagnuolo can sit in Cover-2 and take away the 27-yard shot, or he can zone-blitz to turn 10 hits into a sack. Week 6 is which one he trusts on third down.

gamePlan.lede: Week 6 is Los Angeles at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium on Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT (CBS). Kansas City is a 71.6 percent ESPN FPI favorite at home, which is a 4-0 price, not a Herbert tax. The assignment is to make the Chargers beat a 189-yard run identity and a two-deep shell, because the last opponent just posted 28 first downs and 365 net passing yards against hits that never became sacks.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Styles collide in the AFC West the same way they did at Allegiant, except the visiting quarterback is better. Kansas City wants Walker on early downs and explosives off play-action looks it did not need to name last week; Los Angeles wants Herbert to live in the same 11-personnel volume Cousins just used for 31-of-52. The leverage is the box. If the Chargers load it for Walker, Worthy and Kelce have to win. If they play two-high, Walker should see the same 22-carry game. Protection is the hidden matchup: eight hits and two sacks on Mahomes is a starting point for a Chargers pass rush, and Kansas City's 10 hits with zero sacks is a starting point for Herbert if Spagnuolo does not change the math.

keys.title: Make Walker the first answer
keys.body: Open in inside zone and stay there until Los Angeles puts an extra hat in the box. Walker's 177 on 22 carries is the only volume the offense proved at Allegiant; 15-of-30 does not travel as a plan.

keys.title: Two-deep on Herbert's shots
keys.body: Ian Thomas' 27-yard score, Cody White's 27-yarder, Bowers' 20-yard score, and Tre Tucker's 23-yarder are the shots Cover-2 is built to erase. Take those away and make Herbert throw into the five under.

keys.title: Turn 10 hits into a sack
keys.body: The zone blitz is the call, not a takeaway credit from last week. Drop a lineman, rush a second-level player, and do not let Herbert play the Cousins game of 52 attempts with a clean shirt.

keys.title: Protect Mahomes without hiding him
keys.body: Eight hits and two sacks are the number. Mix Walker screens and mesh to Kelce so the Chargers cannot tee off on a thinned receiver room, then still take the four-verticals shot when the safety sits on Walker.

script: 1st-and-10, 12 personnel: Walker inside zone, Tonga as the extra body, same downhill identity that produced 189 rushing yards.
2nd-and-medium: four verticals to Worthy and a Kelce seam — replace Thornton's 42- and 55-yard shots without hunting hero ball every snap.
3rd-and-5: mesh to Kelce and Gray. They combined for four catches on 15-of-30; this is how you stop living at 5-of-13.
When the Chargers rush: Walker spacing screen off his 23-touch role, line leading in space so the eight-hit tape does not repeat.
Early downs vs Herbert: Cover-2 shell, Delane and the corners rally, safeties on top of the go ball.
3rd-and-7 vs Herbert: Spagnuolo zone blitz. Ten hits and zero sacks is the look you are correcting, not celebrating.

nextGame.label: Week 6 · Sun, Oct 18 · 3:25 PM CT
nextGame.note: 4-0 AFC West home game after the bye, with ESPN FPI at 71.6 percent and a receiver room missing Thornton.

spotlight.title: Walker is the 4-0 identity
spotlight.body: Twenty-two carries, 177 yards, two rushing touchdowns, 23 touches inside a 189-yard team day. Arrowhead Pride is already putting him next to the franchise's best backfields, and Arrowhead Addict has Chiefs rushing history in view. The Chargers are the first defense that gets a full week to take it away.

spotlight.title: Thornton's ankle is the roster problem
spotlight.body: Five catches, 111 yards, two touchdowns, then a dislocated ankle on the 55-yarder. Arrowhead Pride reports Stukes was not fined and that Thornton could be a postseason timeline, which still leaves 13 regular-season games. Rice remains short-term. That is a live search, not a depth chart.

spotlight.title: Worthy exploded. He is not a room.
spotlight.body: The 41-yarder and four catches are the vertical Kansas City has to scale, which is why Arrowhead Addict wants more of that tape. An ESPN insider on the same site questions whether Worthy can solve the crisis. Week 6 is the first game that question is not theoretical.

spotlight.title: Araiza just won AFC Player of the Week
spotlight.body: Chiefs.com notes he dropped all five punts inside the 20, and the Allegiant tape also gave him a 12-yard rush from punt formation. Field position is how you survive 24:18 of possession. He has to do it again against Los Angeles.

spotlight.title: Norman-Lott can wait
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Addict's read is that Omarr Norman-Lott remains an unknown for a front that does not need to rush him back. The live issue is finishing: 10 hits, zero sacks on Cousins. Herbert will make that number look worse if the extras are not ready.

spotlight.title: 71.6 percent is a favorite, not a bye
spotlight.body: ESPN FPI has Kansas City at 71.6 percent and Los Angeles at 28.2 percent. Polymarket's 10.3 percent championship price and 18.5 percent AFC ticket still treat 4-0 as a sample after a 30-27 win that cost Thornton. Price it like a home favorite that has to earn the clock.

matchups.unit: Chiefs run game vs. Chargers front
matchups.chiefs: Kenneth Walker III (22-177-2, 23 touches) and a 189-yard team identity
matchups.opponent: Chargers run defense, extra hat in the box
matchups.note: Walker just posted 177 on 22 carries against a Raiders front that could not make him one-dimensional. If Los Angeles loads the box, the pass game has to answer without Thornton.

matchups.chiefs: Mahomes 15-of-30, 225 yards, 2 TD; Worthy 4 catches; Kelce 2
matchups.opponent: Chargers secondary vs. a thinned room
matchups.note: Thornton’s 111 yards and two scores are out long-term and Rice is short-term. The 41-yarder to Worthy is real; four catches and a two-catch Kelce afternoon is not a finished passing game.

matchups.chiefs: 10 QB hits, 0 sacks on Cousins; Karlaftis / Anudike-Uzomah
matchups.note: Hits without sacks is how Las Vegas attempted 52 passes and held the ball 35:42. Herbert is the upgrade on that script unless the zone blitz actually lands.

matchups.unit: Chiefs run defense vs. Chargers backs
matchups.chiefs: Held Las Vegas to 72 rushing yards on 26 carries
matchups.opponent: Chargers run game behind Herbert play-action volume
matchups.note: Jeanty needed 21 touches to find yards that were not there. If the front stays stout, Herbert is forced into the two-deep throws Kansas City can live with.

matchups.chiefs: Travis Kelce (2 catches) and Noah Gray (2)
matchups.opponent: Chargers linebackers and safeties in man
matchups.note: The talent edge is still Kelce. The usage edge is not, not after four combined catches. Mesh has to be on the call sheet so 15-of-30 does not repeat.

matchups.chiefs: Matt Araiza (AFC ST POW, 12-yard fake-punt-look rush)
matchups.note: Araiza pinned all five inside the 20, and Bassa-Cochrane already proved a kickoff can become a touchdown drive. Field position is the 24:18 survival tool.

xsandos.title: Walker downhill, extra hat attached
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10, 12 personnel, opening script vs. Los Angeles at Arrowhead
xsandos.why: Walker just ran 22 times for 177 yards; stay downhill so Herbert never inherits a 35:42 script.
xsandos.coaching: Bieniemy: zone steps, one cut from Walker, Tonga as the extra body. Do not live in the 1-yard downs that turned it over at the Las Vegas 49.

xsandos.title: Replace Thornton with seams
xsandos.why: Thornton is out long-term; Worthy's 41-yarder is the remaining shot that keeps a safety from sitting on Walker.
xsandos.coaching: Worthy through the deep middle, Kelce on the seam, outside receivers past the corners. Mahomes has to take the throw he missed to Worthy late against Las Vegas.

xsandos.title: Manufacture Kelce on third down
xsandos.why: Kelce and Gray combined for four catches on a 15-of-30 day; rubs create the completions the explosives cannot be every snap.
xsandos.coaching: Kelce over the ball, Gray as the rub, Walker as the checkdown. This is how Reid and Bieniemy stop another 5-of-13 chart before Herbert's offense gets the ball back.

xsandos.title: Easy offense when they hunt Mahomes
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-8, Chargers pin-rushing off eight hits and two sacks
xsandos.why: Los Angeles will hunt the eight hits and two sacks Mahomes just took; get Walker the ball in space off 23 touches.
xsandos.coaching: Line lead in space, Walker north after the catch, Mahomes a simple dump. Do not let the Chargers turn protection stress into the entire drive.

xsandos.title: Take the 27-yard ball off Herbert
xsandos.why: Las Vegas posted 365 net passing and 28 first downs; two-deep erases the 27-yard shot and makes Herbert throw into five under.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo: safeties on top of the go balls, Delane and the corners rally to White/Bowers-type catches, no free access down the sideline.

xsandos.title: Simulated heat on third down
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-7 vs. Herbert, must-have stop after a 10-hit, 0-sack tape
xsandos.why: Kansas City recorded 10 quarterback hits and zero sacks on Cousins; this is the call to make Herbert throw on time, not a takeaway claim.
xsandos.coaching: Show the extra hat, drop a lineman, rush a second-level player. Karlaftis and Anudike-Uzomah cannot both chase upfield if the throwing lane is the hole they left.

coaching.topic: Andy Reid / Eric Bieniemy vs. a thinned room
coaching.detail: The 189-yard run game is the identity that survived 15-of-30. Reid's faith in Bieniemy is the early-down plan; the third-down plan has to put Kelce back on the ball so Walker is not the entire answer against Los Angeles.

Ten hits and zero sacks is the look Herbert will feast on if it repeats. Cover-2 on early downs and the zone blitz on third down are the corrections, not a rewrite of a defense that already held Las Vegas to 72 rushing yards.
Eight hits and two sacks on Mahomes is the Chargers' invitation. Screens and mesh are the answers; four verticals is the shot. Do not ask Mahomes to recreate Thornton's 55-yarder every series.

injuries.note: Dislocated his ankle on the 55-yard catch-and-run in the 30-27 win. Arrowhead Pride reports the NFL did not fine Treydan Stukes and that Thornton could be pointed at a postseason return, with 13 regular-season games still to play.
Listed alongside Thornton as a reason Kansas City may add to the receiver room, with Rice framed as short-term and Thornton as long-term.

personnel.move: Receiver search: Justin Watson vs. a real add
personnel.detail: Kansas City is reportedly one of several teams interested in free agent Justin Watson. Arrowhead Addict reads it as familiarity over upside; Arrowhead Pride asks whether the club will revisit the offseason receiver plan after Thornton and Rice.
Four catches and a 41-yarder are the live perimeter tape. That is the job until a roster add lands, not a completed WR1 transition.
Khyiris Tonga reported eligible twice against Las Vegas, including a no-gain at midfield. The package stays in the game plan if Walker is going to keep seeing loaded boxes.
The defensive front does not need to rush Omarr Norman-Lott back to fix a 10-hit, zero-sack problem. That is a Spagnuolo call, not a debut.

strategies: Feed Walker early and often until Los Angeles puts an extra defender in the box; 22 carries and 177 yards is the proven math.
Play Cover-2 on Herbert's early-down shots so 27-yard completions are not the Chargers' first answer.
Zone-blitz on third down to turn the last game's 10 hits into an actual sack, without emptying the middle for Bowers-style throws.
Script mesh and sit-ins for Kelce and Gray so 15-of-30 does not become the passing identity.
Use Walker screens when the Chargers hunt the eight-hit, two-sack tape on Mahomes.
Let Araiza keep pinning inside the 20; 24:18 of possession requires field position and another takeaway opportunity on returns.
debates: Is Justin Watson a real Week 6 answer, or is Kansas City patching the receiver room with a familiar name?
Can Worthy’s four-catch, 41-yard tape replace Thornton’s 111 yards against a Chargers secondary?
How many carries is too many for Walker if the Chargers sell out to stop 177?
Should Spagnuolo sit in two-deep or keep bringing simulated pressure after 10 hits and zero sacks?
Does 4-0 with 24:18 of the ball still count as control, or is this a takeaway team until third down is fixed?

runOfShow.talkTrack: Four-and-oh, 30-27 at Allegiant, Walker 177, Thornton down on the 55-yarder. Herbert is next at Arrowhead on Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT. We are not pretending 28 first downs allowed is a finished defense.

Walk through the scoring in order: Thomas 27 yards at Q1 8:10, Kansas City ties at Q1 2:23, the field-goal half, 17-13, then 17-19. Bind the 2-yard score at Q4 3:21 to 23-19, then Bassa's force and Cochrane's recovery, then Walker right end for 22 and 30-19. Bowers 20 yards makes it 30-27. Nwankpa ends it. Separate 189 rushing and 210 net passing from Las Vegas' 72, 365, and 437.

Mahomes: 15-of-30, 225 yards, two touchdowns, two sacks, eight hits. Explosives to Worthy and Thornton. Kelce two catches, Gray two. That is the passing game the Chargers will see unless mesh is on the script.

Bye is over. Thornton long-term, Rice short-term, Watson rumors, Worthy as the remaining vertical. Walker is the identity. 24:18 of possession and 5-of-13 third down are the fixes. Cite Arrowhead Pride on the ankle and the receiver search.

FPI 71.6 percent is a home favorite, not a Herbert discount. Run Walker, Cover-2 the shots, zone-blitz on third down, screen the rush. Credit Los Angeles: they can post the 28 first downs if the rush stays hits.

Four offense: inside zone, four verts, mesh, Walker screen. Two defense: Cover-2 and the zone blitz as a call. Tie every card to Thornton being out, the 10-hit zero-sack tape, and Herbert at Arrowhead.
Watson or a real add. Worthy as WR1. Walker volume. Two-deep or heat. Send them out looking at Sun Oct 18, 3:25 PM CT, then Seattle on Sun Oct 25, 7:20 PM CT.
